source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of aldehydes (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: Aldehydes primary alcohols ko tezaabi K2Cr2O7 ya tezaabi KMnO4 se oxidise kar ke banaye jate hain: CH3CH2OH + [O] -> CH3CHO + H2O (K2Cr2O7 + H2SO4(aq), garmi).

Ethanal banane ke liye tezaabi K2Cr2O7 qatra qatra garam ethanol mein dala jata hai, aur ethanal bante hi distil kar ke nikal liya jata hai. Is se is ki mazeed oxidation ethanoic acid mein nahi hoti. Darja hararat ethanal (acetaldehyde) ke ubalne ke darje se oopar lekin ethanol ke darje se neeche rakha jata hai, jo zyada darje par ubalta hai. Khalis ethanal dobara distillation se milta hai.

blocks.alt: Aala: tezaabi K2Cr2O7 dropping funnel se garam water bath mein rakhe flask ke garam ethanol mein tapakta hai; thermometer bukharat ka darja hararat batata hai; bukharat paani se thande kiye condenser (paani neeche se andar, oopar se bahar) se guzarti aur ethanal test tube mein jama hota hai.
blocks.caption: Ethanal ko bante hi distil karna (Figure 23.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ethanal ethanol se kaheen kam darje par ubalta hai, is liye jab water bath ethanal ke ubalne ke darje se garam lekin ethanol se thanda ho, ethanal bante hi bukharat ban kar nikal jata aur dichromate ke mazeed oxidise karne se pehle thanda ho kar jama ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Methanal
blocks.text: Methanal, HCHO, kamre ke darja hararat par gas hai. Yeh aksar 40% aabi mehlool ki shakal mein milta hai jise formalin kehte hain, jis ki tez, na-pasandeeda boo hai aur jo hayatiyati namoone mehfooz rakhne mein use hota hai. Doosre chhoti zanjeer wale aldehydes aur ketones maaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Ethanal bante hi distil kar ke kyun nikala jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Warna tezaabi dichromate use mazeed oxidise kar ke ethanoic acid bana deta.

items: Aldehyde bante hi distil karein taa ke tezaab tak oxidation na ho.
